parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, counted from 1.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only onboardings currently in this status.

schema.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
schema.title: WorkflowStatus

parameters.name: workflowVersion
parameters.description: Only onboardings pinned to this workflow revision.

parameters.name: currentStep
parameters.description: Only onboardings waiting on this step.

parameters.name: agreementStatus
parameters.description: Only onboardings whose derived agreement status is this one.

schema.description: Where an onboarding stands on an agreement family, or on every family it holds: `not_accepted` while there is no accepted version, `outdated` when there is one but a newer version has been published, `current` otherwise. Derived, never stored.
schema.title: OnboardingAgreementStatus

parameters.name: parked
parameters.description: Only onboardings parked on an asynchronous connector (`true`), or only those not parked (`false`).

parameters.name: pendingConnectorId
parameters.description: Only onboardings parked on this connector id.

parameters.name: parkedBefore
parameters.description: Only onboardings parked before this instant, by the park time the engine recorded. A row parked before that time was recorded never matches.
